name: Luke
overview: The Gospel of Luke, written by a physician and addressed to Theophilus, carefully presents an orderly account based on eyewitness testimony to assure the certainty of the Christian faith. Luke emphasizes the reliability of the message, as seen in his intent to provide a thorough and accurate declaration of the events surrounding Jesus Christ. His narrative highlights Jesus' teaching ministry, such as His call to generosity and the promise of abundant blessing for those who give, demonstrating the practical outworking of the Gospel in believers' lives.
